seo.title: Landa Software Solutions | Web Development & Custom Software
seo.description: We build websites, apps and custom software for small businesses, startups and local companies. Design, development, infrastructure and maintenance from one team.

hero.titleHighlight: built and maintained by the same people.
hero.subtitle: We build websites, apps and systems for small businesses, startups and local companies ready to grow with technology — without the headaches.

items.title: Direct access
items.text: You talk to the person writing your code and the person running your servers. No middlemen, no endless email chains.

items.title: From idea to production
items.text: Design, development, deployment and support from one team. No juggling multiple vendors.

items.title: Clear scope and pricing
items.text: Before we start, you get a written proposal covering what's included, what it costs and when it'll be ready.

services.title: What we do
services.intro: We build what your business needs — and keep it running.

items.title: Web development
items.text: Fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-ready company websites, landing pages and online stores. Easy to update, so you don't need us for every small change.

items.title: Web & mobile apps
items.text: Admin dashboards, customer portals, booking systems and MVPs for startups. Products designed to grow with your business.

items.title: Custom software & integrations
items.text: Internal tools, APIs and automation for repetitive tasks. We connect the tools you already use (payments, CRM, invoicing, spreadsheets) and add AI where it delivers real value.

items.title: Infrastructure, hosting & maintenance
items.text: We design, deploy and look after the infrastructure your project runs on: Linux servers and cloud (AWS), containers with Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD to ship changes safely, DNS and Cloudflare, SSL/TLS certificates, backups, monitoring and support. Secure, scalable, highly available environments that keep your business running.

audience.title: Built for businesses ready to move forward

items.title: Small and mid-sized businesses
items.text: Digitize your processes, ditch the endless spreadsheets and save hours of manual work every week.

items.title: Startups
items.text: Launch your MVP fast, validate your idea with real users and scale on a solid technical foundation.

items.title: Professionals & local businesses
items.text: A professional online presence that builds trust and brings in new clients.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.text: A free call to understand your business, your goals and what you need.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: We send you the scope, timeline and budget in writing. No fine print.

steps.title: Iterative development
steps.text: We work in short cycles with frequent demos, so you see progress and can give feedback from day one.

steps.title: Launch & ongoing support
steps.text: We take your project live and stay with you through maintenance and support.

team.title: Who we are
team.intro: We're a small team on purpose. We handle every project ourselves: the people you meet on the first call are the people who build it.

members.name: Diego Amatte
bio: 4+ years building web applications and distributed systems end to end, from frontend to backend. Turns your idea into a product that works: architecture, code, integrations and user experience.

Has built and maintained products for email marketing, fintech (auto loans) and telecommunications companies, working with microservice architectures, integrations with multiple third-party platforms and cloud services. Also built an AI agent on Google Cloud Vertex AI to automate internal processes.

members.name: Luis Nogales Moya
bio: Infrastructure, DevOps, networking and cloud platform specialist. Designs, deploys and maintains secure, scalable, highly available environments for web applications and services.

Works with Linux servers, Docker, Kubernetes and OpenShift, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, cloud services, DNS management with Cloudflare, VPNs and private networks, proxies and load balancing, SSL/TLS certificates, server hardening, databases, backups, monitoring and observability.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope. After our first conversation, we send a proposal with a fixed or phased price, so you know exactly what you're paying for.
It depends on the scope. As a reference, a website is usually ready in 2–4 weeks and a custom app or system in 1–3 months. Your proposal includes concrete dates for each stage.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside the US?
items.a: Yes. We work 100% remotely, in English and Spanish, with clients anywhere.
We offer infrastructure, hosting and maintenance plans that include updates, backups, monitoring and support. You can also hire us by the hour for new features.
Yes. When the project is done, the code, credentials and ownership are yours.
Absolutely. Often the best approach is a simple first version that grows from there.

contact.title: Have a project in mind?
contact.text: Tell us what you need and we'll get back to you within 48 business hours. The first conversation is free.
